finding: Boundary prototype supervision did not outperform class-count-matched random anchors; no automatic temperature/weight/fraction grid.
historical_scope: Earlier MIL used Cellosaurus diagnosis groups and mixed RNA/circRNA inputs. Source read only; old loaders and data were not executed or imported.
next_hypothesis: Preserve the938 original expression columns as attribute tokens in a pair feature branch; encode each column using only the605 original miRNA expression rows, combine with candidate-miRNA expression and attend using the original drug vector.
distinctions: Previous FiLM first compressed a whole RNA profile to32 channels before conditioning and graph propagation.
Previous global routing mixed graph nodes, and previous annotation MIL pooled four diagnosis-defined graph copies.
This potential branch would use original expression columns as attributes, not additional graph node types or cell annotations.
deletion_boundary: Column tokens derived only from original RNA features are independent of target association labels; preserve original graph deletion and verify full model physically before training.
limitations: This is an untested hypothesis, not an achieved improvement or a new method-family claim.
Latent cell-token attention is not cell-specific response evidence or causal explanation.
A model, matched controls, initialization and full protocol still need implementation/verification before new training.
